title: The Triple Crown Champion That Was

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day following the Kikuka Sho, after Agnes Tachyon declared her commitment to her senior year challenges…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Appear live on TV as the Triple Crown champion?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We receive an offer to appear on a morning news program.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it'll take only ten minutes, and it's being held on campus. But most importantly… it'll be broadcasted live.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, never mind. I'm just thinking out loud. Either way, I'd be happy for us to appear on the program!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so…

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Please welcome Agnes Tachyon, winner of the Triple Crown, and her trainer, <username>!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The race seems to have generated no small amount of excitement, and I must admit, it was a significant step forward for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Be that as it may, it's only one step. If anything, I feel as if I've finally reached the starting gate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In other words… the Triple Crown was only the first of my exploits!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Does that mean we can expect even greater leaps forward in the future?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Isn't that a given? The potential we're aiming for is still far off.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If anything, now more than ever, there is research to be done and races to be won!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Wow! I can't wait to watch your career unfold!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes! By all means, allow me to observe the activity of your amygdala.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: And your trainer as well, could you share a few words regarding your outlook for the future?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the past year and a half, Agnes Tachyon has spared no effort in the Twinkle Series (though I wish she'd explain those efforts more often).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, from here on…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All right, then, let's hear your plans for my senior year races. I'm all ears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She made a promise to me. Which means, my stance must remain the same!
choice_data_list: I will continue to believe in Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your passionate words! Well, you sure have a lot on your shoulders, wouldn't you say, Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. I'll take you to the very end. Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Now that we've gotten a glimpse of the bond between the two of you, let's have one final round of applause!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, wait, wait, wait! I haven't said the most important thing yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We didn't agree on any announcements beforehand. Could it be about her next goal or senior year plans? I wait with bated breath.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: To all those watching this live, I hope you're excited, because my trainer and I are now…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Recruiting guinea… Ahem. Recruiting test subjects!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: More experiments are needed if we wish to discover the limits of Umamusume potential. So don't hesitate to join us!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Please contact my trainer with any inquiries. He can be reached twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week at…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Please contact my trainer with any inquiries. She can be reached twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week at…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before she can say anything more, I hurriedly escort her out of the venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But just like she said, the Triple Crown was only the beginning. Our days pressing forward are far from over.
